values.note: Electric sites $32 a night or $192 a week (charged on every electric site, used or not); non-electric sites $27 or $162 a week. On Campspot (read 2026-10-13) the park added a 3.5% credit card surcharge. Dump station $15 for non-campers.

fees.source: https://www.co.iron.wi.gov/DocumentCenter/View/188 ('Electrical sites---$32.00/night / This rate applies on all sites with electrical $192.00/week service, even if not used. / Non-Electrical sites---$27.00/night ... $162.00/week'; 'All fees include sales tax.'; 'Dumpstation (walk-ins)---$15.00/use'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: 11 drive-in sites around one loop (10 with electric, per the county) and 4 walk-in tent sites (6, 7, 14, 15).

sites.source: https://www.co.iron.wi.gov/DocumentCenter/View/187 (map: drive-in pads 1-5 and 8-13, tent symbols 6, 7, 14, 15); https://www.co.iron.wi.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Schomberg-Park-3 ('adding 10 electrical campsites, 4 walk-in tent sites'), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://www.co.iron.wi.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Schomberg-Park-3 ('restrooms with showers, pavilion, dump station and ATV wash station'); map (restroom/shower and water symbols), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Bookings for a season open January 1; the county strongly encourages reserving. Also by phone to Iron County Forestry & Parks.

note: Iron County campground on US 51, renovated in 2009, with a pavilion, an ATV wash station and ATV trail access with a loading ramp next to the campground. --Claude
summary: Iron County page, campground map and fee sheet read (Campspot 403): $32 electric confirmed (tax included), $27 non-electric; 15 sites (11 drive-in, 10 electric; 4 walk-in tent; was 14); showers, flush toilets, dump confirmed; Campspot, bookings open Jan 1. County says open ~May 15-Oct 15 (stored Campspot dates 05-07 to 10-12 left). ATV flag. Not waterfront kept.
